summary: First Citizens BancShares filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an SEC-registered offering of 300,000 depositary shares, each representing a 1/100th interest in a share of 7.500% Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series F, at $1,000 per depositary share for $300 million total. Dividends are non-cumulative, payable quarterly from December 15, 2026, resetting after September 15, 2031 at five-year Treasury plus 2.894%. No exchange listing; redemption at $100,000 per share on or after September 15, 2031, or within 90 days of a regulatory capital treatment event. This is an ordinary shelf takedown of bank regulatory capital, not a special situation; watch for pricing spread, trading discount, and any redemption or capital-treatment developments.
